reason: Each of these names asserts a contract the fitter no longer has. The first two pinned 'a K >> rank fit cannot certify', which measured a support step that was not a descent step rather than an over-complete frame; with the support step descending the shared objective both fits certify. The third pinned that a streaming epoch is invariant to the scale it starts from, which held only because the top-k gate rule ignored gamma -- the same blindness that let the support step raise the objective the frame and gamma steps lower.

reason: The terminal exact-Newton polish no longer globalizes in stationarity-residual currency: #2861 (landed in the codex integration d82efb558) accepts polish steps on Armijo decrease of the penalized objective, because on a resolved negative-curvature mode the objective-descent direction can raise the KKT residual and the old rule rejected exactly the step that leaves the saddle. 'The polish never raises the KKT residual' is therefore not a property the polish has any more; the KKT residual remains the convergence certificate only. The pin is renamed to the invariant the polish now owns, terminal_polish_never_raises_the_penalized_objective_2080, in the same file (crates/gam-sae/src/manifold/construction_tests.rs), alongside terminal_objective_step_descends_resolved_negative_curvature_2080 which pins the mechanism itself.
evidence: Replacement pins are terminal_polish_never_raises_the_penalized_objective_2080 and terminal_objective_step_descends_resolved_negative_curvature_2080 (both #[test] in crates/gam-sae/src/manifold/construction_tests.rs at d82efb558); the retired residual-currency step is kept as a test-only oracle in tests_damped_residual_path so the #2762 pins on it (damped_residual_step_at_zero_damping_is_the_pseudoinverse_step_2762, damped_residual_step_model_residual_is_exact_2762, damping_separates_a_flat_direction_from_a_resolved_one_2762) still compile and run.
